items.title: Today in Social Media Infringement Cases: LG and Kroger Sued for Allegedly Using Viral Track ‘Cheese Tax’ in TikTok Videos
items.summary: Today in social media copyright complaints: A pair of infringement actions against Kroger and LG Electronics, which allegedly incorporated a protected track into TikTok videos without authorization. Georgia-based singer-songwriter Matt Hobbs, the creator of Puppy Songs, submitted the lawsuits to a California federal co…

items.title: Drake Sued Over ‘Janice STFU’ by Producer Who Says Rapper Stole His Chorus
items.summary: Drake is being sued for copyright infringement on his hit “Janice STFU” by a producer who says the rapper and his team “shamelessly refuse to acknowledge” his substantial contributions. Drake has been hit with a copyright infringement lawsuit over his hit song “Janice STFU” by a producer named Aviel Calev Hirschfield,…

items.title: Elephant In the Room Reminder: Major Hits from Kylie Minogue and Nick Cave Already Used to Train AI Without Compensation, the ICMP Tells Australian Legislators
items.summary: The global trade body ICMP warns that AI training may lead to the dilution of Australian copyright laws, effectively “legitimizing larceny.” The International Confederation of Music Publishers (ICMP) has cautioned the Australian government against giving in to efforts from tech companies seeking to weaken copyright law…

items.title: Labels’ fail in bid to get Supreme Court to overturn termination-rights ruling
items.summary: The three major labels and BMG have failed in their bid to get the US Supreme Court to overturn a ruling that artists can exert their ‘termination rights’ to regain their copyrights globally, not just in the US. The post is from Music Ally .

items.title: Sony and Universal Demand DistroKid AI Music Upload Data in Copyright Battle
Kroger and LG sued by Puppy Songs creator over alleged unlicensed use of TikTok hit ‘Cheese Tax’
items.summary: Each complaint seeks damages set by law of up to $150,000 per infringed work and a court order barring the company from further infringing Hobbs' rights. Source

‘Human Made, Human Paid’: The Largest U.S. Musicians Union Is Demanding AI Protections
items.summary: American Federation of Musicians asking major labels to give artists a contract with AI protections and compensation

items.title: Un músico, condenado a prisión por utilizar "bots" de inteligencia artificial para cobrar millones en derechos de autor
Universal Music appoints first AI director amid copyright lawsuits
Spotify Removes 75 Million Songs Identified as ‘AI-Generated Slop or Spam’
items.summary: The streaming service cut the slop tracks in favor of “more music made by authentic, human artists,” with 50 million more being filtered from recommendations made to listeners

items.title: Deezer permitirá ocultar la música hecha con IA al buscar
items.summary: Deezer permitirá a sus usuarios ocultar la música generada íntegramente con inteligencia artificial. La plataforma francesa ha anunciado un interruptor que, una vez activado, excluirá de los resultados de búsqueda las canciones, los álbumes y los artistas vinculados a contenido 100% sintético. La función llegará a todo…

tip.title: Registra antes de publicar, no después
tip.body: El registro de tu obra no crea el derecho de autor —ese nace con la creación— pero sí te da la prueba con fecha cierta que vale en un juicio. Regístrala antes de subirla a plataformas, no cuando ya tengas el problema.

tip.title: Register before you release, not after
tip.body: Registration doesn't create your copyright —that exists from the moment of creation— but it gives you dated proof that holds up in court. Register before uploading to platforms, not after trouble shows up.
